audit.whatIsWrong: win[0] and phases[0] give Level 1 to Camille while spikes[0].text, early and whys[0] all say 'Level 1 belongs to Malphite'. The row contradicts its own explanation.
audit.why: The mirror file audits/top/malphite__camille.json found the identical contradiction from the other side and could not fix it either: 'side' and 'win[N]' hold 6-8 character values, so 'Camille' (7) to 'Malphite' (8) falls outside the applier's +/-10% band. Both directions agree the PROSE is right and the row is wrong.
audit.corrected: Left both alone rather than fight the band. Raised in questionsForUser; this needs a hand fix or mirror-fix.js.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 is credited to 'his passive shield plus Thunderclap auto'. At level 1 he has exactly one ability, so Thunderclap is not part of that stage. The stage that is actually his is Granite Shield plus whichever single spell he took, and no spike carries a cooldown anywhere in the matchup.
audit.why: Riot, Granite Shield: 'Malphite is shielded by a layer of rock which absorbs damage up to 10% of his maximum Health. If Malphite has not been hit for a few seconds, this effect recharges.' Cooldowns: Seismic Shard 8s flat, Thunderclap 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s, Ground Slam 7s flat, Unstoppable Force 130/115/100s.
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text, early and whys[0] now describe the level-1 stage as Granite Shield plus Seismic Shard's 8s poke, and mid/late carry Unstoppable Force's 130s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two errors and the single biggest omission in the matchup. (1) His R is called 'point-and-click' four times. Unstoppable Force is a charge to a LOCATION at 1000 range - it can be sidestepped and it can miss, which changes whether you respect it the same way. (2) Ground Slam (E, flat 7s) reduces ATTACK SPEED, and it is never mentioned once: your entire Hookshot burst and your R's bonus-magic-damage autos are attack-speed damage, so his E is the ability that actually blanks your all-in. (3) Thunderclap (W) is an auto-attack reset whose aftershocks apply on-hit, so his damage scales with attack speed rather than pure armour stacking. Camille's Hookshot is called a stun; Riot says knock-up.
audit.why: Riot: Unstoppable Force - 'Malphite launches himself to a location at high speed, damaging enemies and knocking them into the air.' Ground Slam - 'sends out a shockwave that deals magic damage based on his Armor and reduces the Attack Speed of enemies.' Thunderclap - 'For the next few seconds, his attacks create aftershocks in front of him.' _missing-interactions.json flags autoreset-burst-tell and onhit-itemization for this pairing.
audit.corrected: spikes[2].text, mid, late and wants.foe[2] now describe a location charge instead of a point-and-click; wants.foe[1] and mid name Ground Slam's attack-speed cut as the thing that kills your burst window.

edits.before: Level 1 belongs to Malphite — his Q slow-poke and passive shield plus Thunderclap auto out-prod your single ability, so don't walk up for a last-hit you'll pay for. The lane flips fast: at 2 with a point in W, and at 3 with Q's re-cast online, you out-trade him. His stacking armor blunts your physical Q hit, W edge, and autos, so the part that hurts him is Q's bonus true damage and W's percent-HP chunk plus the heal off him. Bait his passive shield with an auto, then W-Q-Q and step out before his Thunderclap auto and Q slow catch you.
edits.after: Level 1 belongs to Malphite — Seismic Shard's slow-poke and Granite Shield out-prod your single ability, so don't walk up for a last-hit you'll pay for. The lane flips fast: at 2 with a point in W, and at 3 with Q's re-cast online, you out-trade him. His stacking armor blunts your physical Q hit, W edge, and autos, so the part that hurts him is Q's bonus true damage and W's percent-HP chunk plus the heal off him. Bait Granite Shield with an auto — it only recharges if he goes unhit — then W-Q-Q and step out.

edits.before: This is the even part of the lane and it hinges on level 6. Your R locks him in the arena and deals magic damage his stacked armor does nothing against — on paper you win the isolated 1v1. But his R is unstoppable and point-and-click: the moment you E in to dive, he can flip you mid-dash, peel for himself, or layer it with Q's slow so you never escape. Don't burn your R into his R — trade with Q's true-damage re-cast and W's percent-HP edge, keep chipping his health, and only commit the full E-R all-in when his ult is on cooldown or your jungler can eat his engage.
edits.after: This is the even part of the lane and it hinges on level 6. Your R locks him in the arena for magic damage his armor does nothing against — on paper you win the isolated 1v1. But Unstoppable Force charges 1000 units to a location, so it flips you mid-dash, and Ground Slam (E, 7s) cuts the attack speed your burst runs on. He can also layer Seismic Shard's slow on top so you never get out. Don't burn your R into his 130s R — trade with Q's true-damage re-cast and W's percent-HP outer edge, keep chipping his health, and only commit the full E-R all-in when his ult is on cooldown or your jungler can eat the engage.

edits.before: Neither of you truly takes over late, which is why it sits even. You stay relevant because Q's true damage and R's magic damage cut through the armor he piles on — you can still delete a squishy he can't peel. But Malphite becomes a teamfight problem your dive can't solve: his unstoppable R is a flank-engage that negates your E mobility and locks down your carry, and his armor blunts your physical W and autos in extended fights. Pick him off before fights start, never face-check for his R, and use your isolating ult on his backline instead of trading ults with the rock.
edits.after: Neither of you truly takes over late, which is why it sits even. You stay relevant because Q's true damage and R's magic damage cut through the armor he piles on — you can still delete a squishy he can't peel. But Malphite becomes a teamfight problem your dive can't solve: Unstoppable Force is a 1000-range flank charge that catches your E mid-flight, and Ground Slam saps the attack speed your damage rides on. Pick him off before fights start, never face-check the flank, and ult his backline instead of trading ults with the rock.

notes: MIRROR AGREEMENT: audits/top/malphite__camille.json found the same Level 1 contradiction from his side and hit the same wall - win[0]/phases[0].side say Camille, all the prose says Malphite, and 'Camille' (7 chars) to 'Malphite' (8 chars) is outside the applier's +/-10% band, so neither direction can propose the flip. It needs a hand edit or mirror-fix.js. I also reused the mirror's finding that malphite.json's 'grounding' flags on Q and E are tooltip-parse misfires - Riot's descriptions give a move-speed steal and an attack-speed reduction, nothing that grounds - so I never claimed Malphite can deny Hookshot or the Ultimatum dash. The real find on my side is Ground Slam: a flat 7s attack-speed cut, never mentioned anywhere in this matchup, aimed squarely at the attack-speed burst that is Camille's entire all-in.
